summary:
user: I am busy right now, call me later.
assistant: No problem at all. I have noted that you would like a callback when you are free.
user: I don't know, sometime later.
assistant: Understood. I will arrange for a callback at a later time.
user: Okay, bye.
assistant: I've saved your details and your request for a follow-up call. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
